findings.text: 10.7 (v29 → v30), "The humbling of the soul was not wrong in itself." Isa 58:5 questions the form of the fast, so the verses do not say this. Removed. The passage now reads: "The humbling stood beside oppression in the same people, and it was not what he chooses.".

Claim C-188 (from update 141). It said "In four passages" what God looks to is set against a religious act. That counted only the humility passages, and 13.1 Delight gathers more (Isa 1:11–13; Psa 40:6–8; Hos 6:6; Mat 9:13; 12:7). It is restated to name the humility passages "as in the other passages gathered in 13.1".

Quotes only. These have no statement beyond their verses: 10.1, the oppressor and the persecutor (Psa 10:10; 109:16); 10.7, Psa 81:10–12 in Willing; Ch 4, the stubborn heart and the heart lifted up; 10.13, Their humbling and the humbling bullet; 10.10, 1Ti 2:11–12, where the passage says "I add nothing beyond what the verses state"; Ch 14, Jam 1:21; Ch 12, Before the fall named in Daniel 5:20.

Other concepts, for their own strands: fear: 10.9 Isa 66:2 trembling; 10.12 Psa 76:7–9 stillness; respect in 1Pe 2:18 and 3:15; Eph 5:21 in The words; authority: 10.10 "take a good name for it as well"; the flesh: Ch 12 Rom 8:7; anger and pride as one word: Ch 11 Overflow; "gently" and "gentle" with no humility sense: Isa 8:6 in 10.7; Jer 11:19 in 10.10; judgment: 10.7, Hos 5:11.
